text:
Maya: pushed a tiny PR that updates the hello quickstart flow to the new SDK auth pattern — aim is to make first-deploy less fiddly. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 :seedling:
Sam: nice, quick scan — CI shows a snippet-lint failure in the python example (token formatting). can you paste the snippet here?
Maya: yep, this is what was in the guide:
```python
import os
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('API_KEY'))
resp = client.generate('hello world')
print(resp.text)
```
Maya: changed to REDWOOD_API_KEY to match our env naming, and added the minimal error handling example.
DocsBot: PR opened by Maya — 1 file changed, 2 additions, 1 deletion. CI queued (snippet-lint, smoke-e2e).
Jin: will review in ~30m. small UX ask: call out the local dev fallback (`export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...`) and show both curl + SDK examples. engineers often try only one.
Ashley: tiny nit — in the deploy section you call out `--region=us-west-2` in the CLI snippet but the hosted quickstart should omit region to avoid confusion for new users on managed. suggest we say "optional: --region=... for dedicated/private".
Maya: good catch, updated the text and pushed a commit that replaces the region flag with an optional callout block. also switched the python sample to show `Client.from_env()` helper so it's copy-paste friendly:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client.from_env()
resp = client.generate('Hello from Redwood')
print(resp.text)
```
Kai: FYI I added a tiny smoke e2e step to the docs CI that runs the quickstart flow against staging keys — that caught a flaky hostname resolution issue which I fixed in the test harness. Should stabilize checks.
Sam: re-ran CI, snippet-lint is green now. smoke-e2e failing on timeout (looks like staging node slower). requeue please?
Maya: requeued. also added a short paragraph about the "first deployment" signal (what to expect in <5m vs 30m) and a pointer to Dedicated docs for perf-sensitive teams.
Leo: can we also link the Dedicated/reserved capacity page from the quickstart under "next steps"? i'll add that in a follow-up PR (small editorial).
Jin: reviewed the snippets and copy. left one inline suggestion about clarifying rate-limit headers in the curl example. otherwise LGTM.
Sam: approved. I'll merge once smoke-e2e passes. :white_check_mark:
DocsBot: merge queued by Sam — auto-merge when checks pass.
Maya: thanks all — great fast turnaround. will open a follow-up for the sample app env var matrix (windows vs mac vs linux notes).
Ashley: +1, happy to help with windows examples.
Kai: smoke-e2e passed on retry. merging now. :tada:
DocsBot: PR #4123 merged by DocsBot and deployed to staging docs (build id: docs-2026-03-23-84).
